# Report Template

## Output

The skill produces **one script** and **one PDF**:

```
scripts/generate-report.tsx   ← created by the skill
docs/<project>-report.pdf     ← generated by running the script
```

Nothing goes inside `src/`. No component libraries, no types files, no barrel exports.

---

## Section Order

The PDF follows this exact section order:

```
1. Title Page
2. Table of Contents
3. Executive Summary
4. Tech Stack Inventory
5. Feature Map
   5a. Feature List
   5b. Feature Dependency Graph (SVG diagram)
6. Architecture Overview
   6a. Layer Classification
   6b. Architecture Layers Diagram (SVG diagram)
   6c. Violations (if any)
7. Recommendations
   7a. Bundle Size
   7b. Security
   7c. Best Practices
   7d. Performance
   7e. Tech Stack Improvements
8. Appendix: Full Dependency List
```

---

## Section Content Guidelines

### 1. Title Page

- Project name (from `package.json` `name` field or directory name)
- Report title: "Frontend Architecture Report"
- Generation date in ISO format (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

### 2. Table of Contents

- List the sections above with section numbers.

### 3. Executive Summary

One paragraph (3–5 sentences) covering:

- Framework and primary tech stack
- Number of features identified
- Overall architecture health (healthy / needs attention / critical)
- Top recommendation

### 4. Tech Stack Inventory

A table with columns: Category, Library, Version, Status.

Status values: `Current`, `Outdated`, `Deprecated`.

### 5. Feature Map

#### 5a. Feature List

For each feature: name, path, internal modules, dependencies, API endpoints.

#### 5b. Feature Dependency Graph

Rendered using react-pdf SVG primitives. See diagram-generation.md.

### 6. Architecture Overview

#### 6a. Layer Classification

A table listing each layer and its directories.

#### 6b. Architecture Layers Diagram

Rendered using react-pdf SVG primitives. See diagram-generation.md.

#### 6c. Violations

If violations found, list source → target → description.
If none: "No architecture layer violations detected. ✓"

### 7. Recommendations

For each category: score (1–5), one-sentence summary, bulleted action items.

### 8. Appendix: Full Dependency List

Two tables: production dependencies and dev dependencies (name + version).

---

## Data Shape

All analysis data is defined **inline** in the script as a single constant.
No separate types file. Here is the shape for reference:

```ts
const data = {
  projectName: string,
  generatedDate: string,           // "YYYY-MM-DD"
  techStack: {
    category: string,
    name: string,
    version: string,
    status: "current" | "outdated" | "deprecated",
  }[],
  features: {
    name: string,
    path: string,
    internalModules: string[],
    dependencies: { target: string, type: "cross-feature" | "shared" }[],
    apiEndpoints: string[],
  }[],
  layers: {
    name: string,
    directories: string[],
  }[],
  violations: {
    source: string,
    target: string,
    description: string,
  }[],
  recommendations: {
    category: string,
    score: number,
    summary: string,
    items: string[],
  }[],
  productionDeps: { name: string, version: string }[],
  devDeps: { name: string, version: string }[],
};
```
